name: wild-willows
description: Wild Willows — a cozy nature-restoration life sim, backed by Harper

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:web

comment: The Harper WEB deploy is prebuilt (bundled resources.js + static web/) and the client baked into web/assets, so it needs no runtime npm deps — phaser/react/etc. stay out of `dependencies` on purpose. `steamworks.js` is the desktop-only native module that electron-builder must package (it only bundles production `dependencies`, and asarUnpack references it). `harper` is here for local web dev (`harper dev .`) — the desktop app no longer spawns a local Harper (solo runs in-app; co-op uses the hosted server). NOTE: if `harper deploy` installs `dependencies` server-side, move `harper`/`steamworks.js` out (e.g. to a desktop-only package) so the web deploy stays clean.
